Why we pre-order

We are a small-batch, family-run shop, and the two of us make everything. We'd love to have every flavor waiting for you all day, but with the quality of ingredients we use and the care each batch takes, that simply isn't possible. Pre-orders let us bake exactly what you want, fresh, with nothing wasted. Thank you for your continued support.

Donutste · Lake Mary, Florida

Best donut and pastry in the world.

Donuts, cinnamon rolls and pastries made by two chefs, in small batches, every week.

The dough

Seventy-two hours.

Every batch rests for three days before it meets the oven. We never rush it, which is why we stay small batch.

The palate

Balanced, never just sweet.

The best pastry chefs agree: a great dessert never tastes only sweet. Salt makes sweetness shine, acid brings contrast, and a little bitterness adds depth. We build every pastry that way.

Our roots

Chefs first.

Before Donutste, we cooked. For more than a decade in New York City we cooked private dinners and events for celebrities, artists and families: Toni Morrison, The Breakfast Club, NFL players, Moncler's executive team and New York Fashion Week.

We took everything that kitchen taught us about seasoning, texture and balance, and put it into pastry. That became Donutste.

Chef Victoria & Chef Shalom

Welcome home.
Our story.

We are Chef Victoria and Chef Shalom. We started baking while we were homeless in New York, and our donuts became a cult, underground phenomenon in the city, carried by Guy & Gallard and Orchard Grocery. New Jersey came next with Tonnie's Minis, then Florida farmers markets and pop-ups, then a little pink cottage, and now our own kitchen in Lake Mary.

We are family-run, locally owned and the first Black-owned bakery in Lake Mary. It is still just the two of us and our son, making every batch by hand.
